title: Specify and implement the normative event envelope v0.1
objective: Turn the draft event envelope into a canonical, replay-tested protocol object covering identity, parents, actor lineage, valid/observed/recorded time, payload digest, visibility, signatures, and supersession.
acceptance: canonical bytes and event IDs are specified without implementation ambiguity
parent and chain validation reject missing, cyclic, and equivocated history
three-time semantics are represented without forcing false precision
supersession never mutates accepted prior events
reference fixtures replay identically in a clean clone
